messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: control-plane dependency error spike detected · elevated 5xx rate across gateway → auth/org-lookup/billing paths · avg 5xx = 12.3% over last 5m · p95 latency auth = 620ms · pager triggered
emma (oncall): I’m on it — paging eng-sre and platform. any obvious recent deploys to control-plane? :eyes:
raj (eng-sre): saw a few config pushes ~10m ago to auth-config-service (feature flags for org lookup caching). grabbing logs now.
maria (platform): rollout id fc-2026-09-12 pushed at 1995554200 — can try pinning to previous if needed.
tyler (runtime): metrics show gateway 502 spikes when backend auth responds with 504s. possible circuit-breaker thrash.
nash (support): getting multiple customer-reported 502s for API key validation — cs ticket numbers referenced in RL: #CS-8821 #CS-8822
emma (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestions? fallback to cached org data? increase auth replicas?
raj (eng-sre): steps I’m doing: 1) querying auth pod logs 2) checking k8s events 3) inspect service mesh retries. running: `kubectl -n controlplane get pods -l app=auth-service` then `kubectl logs -f auth-service-7f5d -c auth`
raj (eng-sre): log tail shows repeated timeout to billing-lookup: `timeout waiting for response from billing-lookup (upstream)`. stack traces show blocking DB calls in auth during org enrichment.
tyler (runtime): looks like auth instances exhausting threadpools under slow billing calls. immediate: enable short-circuiting for org enrichment — drop enrichment for the gateway path and return user with minimal payload.
maria (platform): I can pin traffic to previous config (fc-2026-09-05) for auth-config. rolling that now to reduce config-induced behavior. initiating rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/auth-config auth-config=registry/redwood/auth-config:fc-2026-09-05`
emma (oncall): notify customers? severity?
nash (support): CS recommends banner + status page update: Customers impacted: API key validations for hosted API in US region — ~4% of active requests.
incident-bot: PAGED: @emma (oncall) · priority: P0 · channel: #incidents · reason: 5xx spike control-plane deps
raj (eng-sre): temporary hotfix applied: added a 100ms timeout to billing lookup calls inside auth and enabled async fallback. also bumped auth replicas from 3 -> 6 in us-west: `kubectl scale deploy/auth-service --replicas=6 -n controlplane`
tyler (runtime): deployed ephemeral fail-open: when billing lookup > 250ms, return cached billing info if available. added circuit-breaker config: maxConsecutiveErrors=10 -> 50 to prevent immediate tripping.
maria (platform): rollback completed at 1995554602. watching metrics.
deploy-bot: Rollback fc-2026-09-12 → fc-2026-09-05 completed by maria at 1995554602 · CI: ✅ · canary: ✅
emma (oncall): after rollback + scaling + timeout/async fallback — what's the current 5xx?
raj (eng-sre): monitoring: 5xx dropped from 12.3% -> 1.1% over 7 minutes. p95 auth latency now 210ms.
nash (support): CS: customers on hold for status update. recommend sending short note after stabilization.
tyler (runtime): one more check: make sure cache TTL trim for org fallback is safe. I set TTL=60s for now.
emma (oncall): ok — looks stable but flag for postmortem. creating incident ticket and assigning owners.
emma (oncall): HANDOFF / SUMMARY for next oncall: cause: auth enrichment to billing service slowed after config change causing threadpool exhaustion and circuit-breaker interplay · mitigations performed: rollback config, scaled auth service, added short timeouts + async fallback, raised circuit breaker threshold, enabled cached fallback for org/billing paths · customer impact: ~4% of requests showed 502/504 during peak window (1995554180 - 1995554600) affecting hosted API US region only · current status: stabilized (5xx ~1.1%).
emma (oncall): ACTIONS & OWNERS: - raj: followup root cause & monitor for recurrence (bug ticket: RED-INC-2345) - tyler: evaluate threadpool settings and add safer defaults (PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/789) - maria: add traffic-safe deploy guard for control-plane config (config gating) - ash: CS post to customers once final confirm
raj (eng-sre): opened RED-INC-2345 with logs and timeline. attaching heap/profile samples and k8s events.
nash (support): prepared draft status message on status.redwood.ai — waiting final confirmation.
tyler (runtime): small note: we should add a runtime metric for sync DB call latency inside auth to trip earlier. filing monitoring alert: MON-4492.
emma (oncall): if no further regression by EOD I’ll close pager. handoff to night team: please watch auth 5xx and org-lookup latency, pager if >3% for 10m.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager silenced for 30m by @emma (oncall) while monitoring.
nash (support): CS update posted at 1995554900: "We experienced transient elevated 5xx errors impacting API key validation in US. The issue has been mitigated and services are stable. Follow-up investigation is ongoing."
emma (oncall): last check — 5xx = 0.9% over last 5m, p95 auth = 195ms. closing loop here. will do a postmortem tomorrow with timeline and recommended deploy guard. thanks everyone. :heart:
raj (eng-sre): leaving a short note for runbook update: add step to disable org enrichment on auth during high-latency upstreams.
_reserved_for_search: control-plane auth org-lookup billing 5xx spike paging rollback scale timeout async fallback circuit-breaker cached fallback postmortem RED-INC-2345
